_about: The courier office's job board (JobBoard). Each job: board (which board), order, title, taken_flag / done_flag, description (shown before taking), take {text, give_items, set_flags}, taken_text (reminder), done_text. Placeholder text until the Writer's M6-2 pass. The main job is finished at the tower (M4); the two side deliveries finish in town: 'The dark window' when the lamp is lit on Lamp Square, 'Appeal in triplicate' when the form is dropped in the checkpoint's APPEALS slot (scenes dark_window_light and appeal_deliver in story_scenes.json).

main.title: Main: Crate to the Tower
description: MAIN JOB. One crate, from Otis's dock office to the Old Relay Tower.
Ordered by Watch Zero. Supplies for the sit-in. Thermoses, cushions. Do not ask.

take.text: Job taken. Courier Job Slip in hand. Otis's dock office is down the stairs.

taken_text: Crate, one, from Otis's dock office to the Old Relay Tower. Why are you still reading?

dark_window.title: Side: The dark window
description: SIDE JOB. Lamp oil, one can, to the dark window on Lamp Square. Tonight.
Pay: a Lucky Bolt and 100 credits.

take.text: Oil can handed over. It's the one dark window on the square.

taken_text: Lamp oil to the dark window on Lamp Square. Hop the crates up to the little balcony.
done_text: Window's lit. Stamped DONE. Pay's on the sill.

appeal.title: Side: Appeal in triplicate
description: SIDE JOB. Collect a form from Pell at the docks. Deliver it to the checkpoint.
Pay: 150 credits and two Appeal Forms.

take.text: Job taken. Pell's on the docks.

taken_text: Get the form from Pell at the docks. Drop it in the checkpoint's APPEALS slot.
done_text: Appeal filed, in triplicate. Stamped DONE.
